entries.name: Hardware shop
entries.description: Traditional one-storey brick hardware shop with a strong slate roof and broad ochre window canopy. Ordinary2.1m entrance, no tool grids.

entries.name: Florist
entries.description: Traditional small timber florist with a clean green pitched roof, broad dark glazing and two broad muted plant clusters. No flower dots.

entries.name: Grocer

entries.name: Bakery

entries.name: Butcher

entries.name: Hardware shop

entries.description: Modern ecological one-storey timber-and-glass florist with one broad planted roof strip and two restrained plant clusters. No tiny flower speckles.

1.method: Manual personnel doorway edge measurements on the generated taiga source, normalized by the complete source grid cell (approximately ±2px); one median reference per footprint tier.

registration: Original disconnected RGBA pixels retained. A measured doorway factor is uniform for every complete cutout in a source family/footprint tier; alpha bounds locate ground contact only, never choose scale. Fixed master contact anchor (128,244), full 256px parcel grid retained. No runtime per-kind multiplier.
